slides.title: 3 things to put *first* on a driver CV
slides.sub: Swipe. Save this for your next application.

slides.title: Your licences
slides.body: Licence categories, extra entitlements and your driving record status go at the top, before your work history. Add expiry or renewal dates honestly.

slides.title: Reliability, with real numbers
slides.body: Parcels or stops per day, years without an at-fault incident, on-time rate. Use only figures you know. "Around 120 a day" beats an invented percentage.

slides.title: The vehicles and kit
slides.body: Vans, rigid or articulated trucks, taxis, forklifts, scanners, tachographs, sat-navs. Use the same words as the job advert.

slides.title: Keep the history short
slides.body: Job title, company, dates and two or three lines each. Older or short jobs can be one line.

slides.title: Build your driver CV in minutes
slides.sub: Upload the one you have or start fresh. Free to start. Full guide: aicvstudio.app/cv-for/drivers
